title: Q1 2026 Yellow Taxi Demand & Fares
summary: Q1 2026 yellow taxi: 11.08M trips; March busiest at 3.95M and February quietest at 3.40M. Median fare ran $15.60-$16.30 while median total ran $23.05-$24.00. Demand peaks 17:00-19:00, strongest Thursday-Friday. Upper East Side South is the top pickup zone (479.8K trips); JFK Airport leads average fare at $57.90.
